comment: The rate knob does not follow a plain exponential law: RandMod7.cpp:300-309 reads a lookup table to turn the knob position into a period in milliseconds, and the tooltip's 2Hz to 10000Hz corresponds to the 500ms and 0.1ms constants at :102-103. Each track's period is the main period divided by its x factor and floored at 0.1ms (:356-357). A track's min and max knobs are swapped when min is the higher of the two (:397-401). The sumRange figures are knob positions rather than voltages: knob plus CV is clamped to 0-1. The seven strength jacks are arranged in two diagonals on the panel, so their panel order is not their index order; the indices run 1 to 4 down the upper diagonal and 5 to 7 down the lower one.
